layer_stack: In1.Cu (AGND left x=0-80mm / DGND right x=80-160mm, single-point join at center)
ground_split_note: Analog GND (AGND) fills In1.Cu left of x=80mm. Digital GND fills right. Single-point connection at x=80mm board center on In1.Cu. Stitching vias at join point. Do NOT bridge AGND/DGND on F.Cu or B.Cu.
routing_notes: ADS1256 AVDD/AVSS: route LC filter from power rails before device. Keep AVDD and AVSS pour separate from digital ground pours.
REF5025 output: short trace to ADS1256 VREFP and DAC8552 VREF pins. Decouple 10uF+100nF close to each load.
ADS1115 inputs: keep analog input traces away from switching regulators and SPI/I2C buses.
DAC output buffers (TLV2374): 100 Ohm series R on each output, placed close to TLV2374.
Power traces: TPS54331 PH/SW node, minimize loop area. L and C close to IC.
CAN bus: 120 Ohm termination R near TCAN1042, not at connector. Route CANH/CANL as differential pair.
I2C bus: 4.7kOhm pull-ups placed near EEPROM (lowest-priority device). Route away from SPI.
Thermal: ICL7660 100uF output cap close to device pin 5 (V_MINUS).
thermal_note: ICL7660 output cap 100uF X5R 10V placed within 3mm of V_MINUS pin. ADS1256 AVDD/AVSS require LC filtering: place 10uF + 100nF within 5mm of pins 1/2. TPS54331 switching node (PH) inductor loop area < 50mm2.
